title: Part Four: The Blockade, and How It Works

sections.brief: 2006–2007: the Hamas election victory, the sanctions, Shalit's capture, the Mecca agreement and the June 2007 fighting; the contested US role. Figures: timeline.
How the closure works: the 2007 cabinet decision, goods, exports, people, sea, land, Rafah; the calorie document; the flotilla and the 2010 easing. Figures: process flow; stats.
What it did: unemployment, GDP, water, power, food, medical exits; the UN's 'liveable' warnings; the legal assessments side by side. Figures: stats; comparison.
